LanguageData.RR_Containment_AlarmDesc: Cut every connection the company has open, right now, and start the return window on each so the crews walk home.\n\nThis is the same action the standing order takes by itself when something gets loose. Use it when you can see the problem coming and the order is disarmed.

LanguageData.RR_Letter_ContainmentCutText: Something is coming off a holding platform, and the standing order was to shut the doors.\n\nConnections cut: {0}. Every crew on the far side is inside its return window and walking back. You can disarm this order from the facilities pane if you would rather decide each time yourself.

LanguageData.RR_Integration_Heading: Optional mods this company has a position on: {0} of {1} loaded
LanguageData.RR_Integration_Caveat: None of these has been tested in play. Loaded means present, not proven.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_VehicleFrameworkPosition: Vehicles stay entirely the other mod's business. Nothing here needs one: a gate is opened on foot, a crew walks through it, and no route, contract or expedition will ever ask you for a vehicle.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_RimWorldTogetherPosition: Each player runs their own company: their own facility, their own gate, their own discoveries, their own research and their own books. Visits and supply exchange are the other mod's features and work as it makes them work. There is no shared map, no shared research, and nothing here transfers a case file or a crew between companies.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_GravshipOnePosition: Orbital travel is a separate way to get about and stays that way. Its air, fuel, power, heat and crew systems are untouched. A gate remains the only way into the Backrooms, and nothing here reads or changes a gravship.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_VehiclesExpandedPosition: Use its vehicles for whatever you like - staging a team, moving stock, carrying somebody home. None of it is required and none of it is changed here.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_GravshipTwoPosition: Its orbital combat, contracts and salvage are its own and are not patched. Nothing it fights will ever turn up in a Backrooms space: what lives in there is drawn only from this mod's own list of inhabitants, and that is checked on every build.
